voiceScript: An open source agent released in February just crossed a hundred and fifty thousand GitHub stars in under four months. As of May it is the most used agent in the world on OpenRouter. It got there by doing one thing most agents still cannot. When it solves a hard problem it saves the solution as a reusable skill file, so next time it already knows how. Persistent memory, scheduled runs, twenty platforms, a five dollar server. Here is where I would slow down. I run sixty plus skills and every one goes through a review pass. This one writes its own, mid run, unreviewed. Follow for more.
